text:
anya: Quick sync — putting together an acceptance checklist for design partner (DP) private beta. Aim: secure infra, telemetry, rollback plan, and clear success metrics before commit. Draft below; please react with :thumbsup: or suggest edits.

kevin: Quick q — do we require full VPC peering or is IP allowlist okay for MVP?

anya: Preference: VPC peering for security-sensitive partners; IP allowlist ok for early pilots if we get audit logs and a scoped retention policy. Capture per-partner gating in the checklist.

sarah: Telemetry needs to be explicit: request logs, per-request trace_id, latency + error histograms, and prompt/response hash for eval reconciliation. Need an SDK hook to annotate user_id + env. Also include sample payloads.

liam: Success metrics proposal:
- Functional: 90% of DP tasks pass the automated eval suite (weights by severity).
- Performance: p90 latency < 300ms (for fallback-hosted path) and p99 < 800ms.
- Cost: token-cost delta <= 15% vs baseline serving profile.
- Reliability: no sustained error rate > 0.5% over 1h window.
If any metric breaches the redline, freeze rollout and triage.

kevin: Rollout plan idea: canary at 5% for 48h, expand to 25% for 72h, then 100% after 7 days if metrics stable. Auto rollback triggers: >3% point increase in error rate or >40% latency regression on p90 vs baseline.

devex-bot: Onboarding checklist draft saved: https://redwood.internal/dp-onboard-checklist (placeholder link)

anya: Action items: kevin -> infra gating doc (includes VPC vs allowlist guidance + feature flags) by Fri; sarah -> telemetry event list + example payloads; liam -> final eval set + weights. I'll pull legal for NDA + retention language and schedule sign-off. Meeting Thurs 10am to approve.

kevin: Noted. I'll add a quick toggle to disable caching/kv for partners so they can test quantization/latency tradeoffs without interfering with global caches.

sarah: Example event snippet I'll add to telemetry doc: ```{
  "event":"request",
  "trace_id":"<uuid>",
  "partner_id":"<id>",
  "prompt_hash":"<sha256>",
  "latency_ms":123,
  "tokens_in":45,
  "tokens_out":120,
  "model_variant":"redwood-v2-q4_1"
}```

liam: Need someone to own the DP reporting dashboard (per-partner pass rates, cost delta, latency histograms). @anya can you assign?

anya: Assigning dashboard ownership to liam, infra gating to kevin, telemetry to sarah. I'll own sign-off + legal touches. Thanks everyone — please drop any objections in thread, otherwise I'll push the checklist PR after Thurs sign-off :thumbsup:

kevin: thumbs up

sarah: :+1:

liam: :party_parrot:
